trades.reasoning: Full multi-signal confirmation (bullish RSI zone, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) justifies a measured buy even on an otherwise neutral market day.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat to slightly down today (NASDAQ -0.0%, S&P 500 -0.4%), a neutral session with no broad risk-on or risk-off signal. We added a measured position in AAPL, the only fully-confirmed candidate with all five bullish signals aligned, while holding all seven existing positions unchanged.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded in a narrow range today with the NASDAQ essentially flat and the S&P 500 dipping slightly, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts in either direction. Without major economic data releases or earnings surprises driving sentiment, trading stayed rangebound and institutional participation was muted. This kind of low-conviction, low-volume day typically favors patience over aggressive repositioning.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢窄幅震盪，納指幾乎持平，標普500則微跌0.4%，反映市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化劑。由於沒有重大經濟數據或企業盈利意外公布，交投保持區間震盪，機構參與度亦偏淡。這種低確信度、低成交量的交易日，通常更適合保持耐性而非積極調整持倉。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Signal confluence means waiting for multiple independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume — to all point the same bullish direction before acting, rather than relying on just one. It's a way to filter out noise and only act on the highest-quality setups, which matters most on days when the broader market isn't giving a clear signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 訊號共振（Signal Confluence）是指在採取行動前，等待多個獨立的技術指標——例如RSI、MACD、移動平均線及成交量——同時指向同一個看漲方向，而非只依賴單一指標。這是一種過濾市場噪音的方法，只在最優質的買入時機出手，在大盤本身缺乏明確方向時尤其重要。
